messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 7):
"""
9) Availability of insurance coverage during grace period: If the premium is paid in instalments during the policy period, coverage will be available for the grace period also. 10) Renewal of Health Insurance Policy: a. A health insurance policy shall be renewable provided the product is not withdrawn, except in case of established fraud or non-disclosure or misrepresentation by the Insured. If the product is withdrawn, the policyholder shall be provided with suitable options to migrate as per the procedure stated under Chapter II of this circular. b. An Insurer shall not deny the renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim (s) in the preceding policy years. c. An Insurer shall not resort to fresh underwriting unless there is an increase in sum insured. In case increase in sum insured is requested
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I pay my health insurance premium in instalments, will I still have coverage during the grace period?","answer":"Yes, coverage will be available for the grace period as well.","facts":["If the premium is paid in instalments during the policy period, coverage will be available for the grace period also"]},{"question":"Can an insurer refuse to renew my health insurance policy simply because I have made a claim in previous years?","answer":"No, an insurer cannot deny renewal on the basis of prior claims.","facts":["An Insurer shall not deny the renewal on the ground that the policyholder had made a claim (s) in the preceding policy years"]}]}
